summary: The terminal UI re-reads a list or conversation st restarted without showing an error, and says which list is stale only once it stays out of date

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Client-only change in the terminal UI feed: an inventory window whose read st restarts is subscribed again after the existing growing, jittered wait (1 s to 30 s), as the core windows already were. Wire frames, commands and scopes are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No additional startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator actions or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
